snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 Story Trailer - PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted 2025
snippet.description:
Get a glimpse at Primarch Lion El'Jonson in the story trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, the upcoming RTS game. Wishlist it on Steam.

Wishlist NOW on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272360/Warhammer_40000_Dawn_of_War_IV/

---
The legendary franchise returns with Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV and a flagship Story Campaign, co-written by legendary Black Library author John French! Classic RTS warfare — reborn. Lead your armies. Claim the battlefield. At last, back to war!

First unveiled at PC Gamer’s Most Wanted, this Dawn of War IV - Story Trailer marks the long-awaited return of Captain Cyrus and the Blood Raven’s to Kronus, the world they’ve sworn to defend, after the events of the Dark Crusade.

The galaxy lies shattered. Kronus stands in ruin. The Blood Ravens stand defiant. Ork Warlords infest the surface, Mechanicus Priests scour the ruins in pursuit of knowledge long forgotten. And buried deep below, an ancient horror stirs. Buried for eons and never meant to return.

But they are not alone. In their hour of greatest darkness The Dark Angels answer their call.

The future is untold, while the fate of Kronus lies in the balance. Only one thing is certain… WAR HAS RETURNED TO KRONUS!
---
